# Mandatory Requirements Assessment

**Mandatory match: 70% (7 of 10)**

| # | Requirement | Match |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | ❌ None listed |
| 9 | Kafka | ❌ |
| 10 | GraphQL | ❌ |

**Note on counting:** Requirement 8 bundles five separate tools into one line. I counted it as one item, as the posting numbers it. If each tool counts separately, there are 14 mandatory items and the match drops to **50% (7 of 14)**.

## ⚠️ Warning: Below the 78% Cutoff

The candidate falls short of your **78% cutoff** under either counting method. The gaps are containerization and infrastructure-as-code (item 8), Kafka, and GraphQL.

Nice-to-have requirements were not evaluated.
